source_read: https://www.jamiesitalian.co.uk/media/nu0n1orc/allergen-menu-080926.pdf (Allergen Menu, Sept V1, 2 pages, created 2026-09-08) and the page https://www.jamiesitalian.co.uk/allergens/ (still links only this allergen file and the June nutrition file), downloaded 2026-10-08 at one request per file with a browser User-Agent; robots.txt only disallows /error.html, /app_data/, /app_plugins/, /bin/, /config/, /data/, /umbraco/, /views/
notes: Parser: tools/uk_extract/jamies_italian_allergens.py reads the text layer (word boxes) of the grid: Contains = contains, MC = may contain (the guide's own find-and-replace of 'may contain': its fryer sentence reads 'Foods cooked in our fryers MC traces'), blank = not listed; no cereal or tree nut is named, so none is published. Independent check by a different method: every dish row of both pages (120 rows, 1,920 cells = 14 allergen columns + Vegetarian + Vegan) was compared with the FILL COLOUR of its cell in a 150 dpi render (pink = Contains, yellow = MC, green = Yes, white = blank): 0 differences; the 60 published dishes' rows in allergens.csv were compared once more against the pixel reading: 0 differences; and about 60 rows were read by eye from rendered crops (all of Spuntino and Antipasto up to Burrata Panzanella, Pizza, the chicken, Pasta, Dolci and Kids tables): all match. The vegetarian/vegan marks read by the older name-based reader agree with the grid reader for every published dish. Exact names only: 60 of 67 published dishes have a row of exactly their printed name. Held back (holdback.csv): Antipasto Plank for 2 (menu prints 'Antipasto Plank' with no size), Giardiniera (prints 'Giardiniera Pickles'), San Danielle Salad Large (one 'San Danielle Salad' row, no size), Pork Milanese, Amalfi Coast Trout and Steak Tagliata (not on the September menu), and Crust Dipper - 'Nduja Hot Honey Mayo (policy 3: a mayonnaise dip whose row marks no egg and no vegan mark). Garlic Bread and Garlic Bread with Nduja Hot Honey are printed twice (starters and sides) with identical rows. Audit: 2 medium flags logged ok in data/audit/reviewed/jamies-italian.csv (Super Green Aioli: the guide marks it Vegan; Prawn Linguine Non Gluten: the gluten-free version). The September allergen menu is three months newer than the June nutrition PDF, so a dish's allergens are those of its September recipe while its numbers are June's (said in note.txt). check_chain.py jamies-italian --fail-on-high: 0 errors, 0 warnings, 0 high, 0 medium flags; built chain has 60 items, all with allergens.
